title: Arithmetic and comparison for Money
prompt: Implement `class Money` (private `long cents_;`, `explicit Money(long)`, `long cents() const`) and, as free functions, `operator+`, `operator-`, `operator==`, and `operator<` over `Money`.

tests.name: add
tests.hint: operator+ returns a new Money by value.

tests.name: eq-lt
tests.hint: Comparisons read the public accessor only.
